title: Case Study: Bank Invests in Cash Recycling Technology
summary: The Cooperative Bank of Kielce boosted efficiency and reduced costs by implementing Diebold Nixdorf's cash recycling technology, ensuring modernized ATM services for customers across Poland.
body_markdown:
The bank introduced DN Series self-service ATMs, including the DN200 and the DN250 models, featuring advanced technology designed to streamline cash management processes.


[Learn More](https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/banking/portfolio/dn-series)


To enhance network efficiency, the bank implemented DN Vynamic software in all DN20H and DN250 models, enabling improved ATM management and enhanced customer interaction.


[Learn More](https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/banking/portfolio/software)


To facilitate a smooth transition, Diebold Nixdorf’s Service Team provided on-site installations and support to ensure seamless implementation with minimal disruption.


[Learn More](https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/banking/portfolio/services/implementation-services)
